build_cliptospec_layer: build a python module that creates a ClipToSpec layer to clip JAX array inputs to a BoundedArraySpec range
build_rescaletospec_layer: build a python module that creates a RescaleToSpec layer to linearly rescale inputs from [-1,1] to a BoundedArraySpec range
build_tanhtospec_layer: build a python module that creates a TanhToSpec layer to squash real-valued inputs with tanh and rescale to a BoundedArraySpec range
test_cliptospec_call: test the ClipToSpec class by calling it with a JAX array and verifying values are clipped to spec bounds
review_rescaletospec_call: review the RescaleToSpec class and verify it correctly maps [-1,1] inputs to the BoundedArraySpec minimum and maximum range
